about_the_game:
Join Sofia on her exciting journey into engineering!


3 Girls in Tech is a Metroidvania-style puzzle-platformer where you will have to help three of the world's most renowned female engineers: Ada Lovelace, Katherine Johnson and Angela Ruiz Robles. Play as Sophia, a brave 11-year-old girl visiting the Center for Women Engineers, and help her through challenging puzzles and platforming on her way!



Complete the most incredible inventions

As you move through the levels, you'll be able to pick up and drop items. But be careful! You'll only be able to take two, so choose wisely. You'll have to activate levels and jump platforms to access new areas and rooms, and you'll also have to do so while dodging dangerous areas and surveillance cameras.

As you complete the levels, you will help the three engineers Ada, Katherine and Angela to build their inventions. But it won't be easy, as Sofia will find all kinds of obstacles in her way, and you'll have to help her overcome them to fulfill her dreams!

Women Engineers in Power


In 3 Girls in Tech, in addition to celebrating a passion for engineering, you can also celebrate diversity in STEM - contribute to a brighter and more equitable future in technology and engineering!

As you help Sofia on her challenging adventure, you can discover the fascinating lives and achievements of pioneering women in STEM. With 3 Girls in Tech, we want to inspire the next generation of women to follow their dreams in the field of engineering, reminding them that there are no limits to what they can achieve.
